► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On March 29, 2022, an officer was dispatched to a suspicious parked vehicle in Janesville, WI. After confronting the driver, he ignored their commands and drove off. A Rock County Sheriff’s deputy later noticed the driver and attempted a traffic stop. He fled again and drove in the wrong direction into oncoming traffic. Eventually, the suspect struck head-on into a deputy’s vehicle and then fled on foot. After hours of searching, he was discovered hiding in the egress window of a residence. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
